name: workday
label: Workday
description: Cloud-based enterprise platform for human resources, finance, and planning.

find_purchase_order.label: Find Purchase Order
find_purchase_order.description: Finds a purchase order by ID in Workday using WQL.

purchaseOrderId.label: Purchase Order ID
purchaseOrderId.description: The ID of the purchase order to find.

body.query: SELECT purchaseOrder FROM purchaseOrders(dataSourceFilter = purchaseOrdersFilter) WHERE purchaseOrder = '{{purchaseOrderId}}'

find_records_wql.label: Find Records (WQL)
find_records_wql.description: Executes a Workday Query Language (WQL) query and returns the results.

query.label: WQL Query
query.description: The Workday Query Language (WQL) query to execute (e.g., "SELECT workdayID, fullName FROM allWorkers").

find_supplier.label: Find Supplier
find_supplier.description: Finds a supplier by ID in Workday using WQL.

supplierId.label: Supplier ID
supplierId.description: The ID of the supplier to find.

body.query: SELECT supplier, supplierName FROM suppliers WHERE supplier = '{{supplierId}}'

get_custom_objects.label: Get Custom Objects
get_custom_objects.description: Retrieves a custom object record by its record ID or, for single-instance objects, by the parent record ID.

definitionId.label: Custom Object Definition
definitionId.description: The custom object definition; its value is the definition alias, e.g. `apTestInfo`.

objectId.label: Record ID
objectId.description: The custom object record ID, or for a single-instance object the ID of the record it is attached to (e.g. the worker WID).
